death.attack.lostfeatures.spike_trap: %1$s stepped on an ancient spike trap
death.attack.lostfeatures.spike_trap.pla: %1$s was pushed onto a spike trap by %2$s
glyph.lostfeatures.inscription.0: "West, then south, then east: so the sun is read on the vault stones."
glyph.lostfeatures.inscription.2: "The eldest flame sleeps beneath the altar of the lair."
glyph.lostfeatures.inscription.3: "Three trophies of three great creatures, set around a heart of ruby."
glyph.lostfeatures.inscription.4: "Our walls stand where the world forgets itself."
glyph.lostfeatures.inscription.5: "Keys of ruby and gold, for locks of oak and iron."
glyph.lostfeatures.inscription.6: "The sensor listens; the logic remembers; the reactor pays."
glyph.lostfeatures.inscription.7: "Do not wake it without the sigil of the three."
journal.lostfeatures.altar_awakened.hint: Hint: Use the sigil on an Ancient Altar in a dragon lair.
journal.lostfeatures.altar_awakened.text: The altar drank the sigil and the mountain answered with a roar.
Hint: Defeat the Ancestral Red Dragon.
The eldest flame is quiet again. Whatever the Emberwrights feared, it rests - for now. Their story is finished; mine is not.
journal.lostfeatures.ancient_site.text: Brick pyramids, a lonely glass pillar, walls of obsidian: markers left by the Emberwrights. Each hides a cache, and many a lock.
journal.lostfeatures.ancient_site.title: Stones That Remember
journal.lostfeatures.dragon_defeated.tex: Scales for armor, a fang for a blade, membranes for the sigil and a heart for the reactor. One victory is enough.
journal.lostfeatures.dragon_sighted.text: A red, earthbound dragon that lands, hunts livestock and guards its territory. It warns before it attacks - heed the roar.
journal.lostfeatures.ender_dragon_victor: The great void dragon has fallen. The Emberwrights wrote that the red dragons are its distant, earthbound kin - smaller, cleverer, and bound to the land.
journal.lostfeatures.far_lands_reached.t: Walls taller than mountains, riddled with tunnels, standing where the world forgets how to be smooth. The Emberwrights called it the Edge.
journal.lostfeatures.first_steps.hint: Hint: Craft a journal from a book and a ruby, or find one in a Starting House.
journal.lostfeatures.first_steps.text: The binding is warm, as if a heart beat inside it. Someone kept a record of a people who studied dragons, bent ruby light into logic and mapped the edge of the world. They called themselves the Emberwrights. I mean to follow their trail.
journal.lostfeatures.first_steps.title: A Ruby-Bound Journal
journal.lostfeatures.giant_defeated.text: It raises its fists before the ground shakes. Step away when the arms go up.
journal.lostfeatures.glyphs_read.hint: Hint: Read an Ancient Glyph Brick.
journal.lostfeatures.glyphs_read.text: The glyphs repeat a warning: 'We bound the eldest flame beneath the altar. Do not wake it without the sigil of the three.'
journal.lostfeatures.glyphs_read.title: Glyphs of Fire
journal.lostfeatures.illusioner_defeated: Mirror images and a blink-step. Watch for the one image that casts no shadow of doubt: it is the one that shoots.
journal.lostfeatures.killer_bunny_defeat: It hides among ordinary rabbits. The red eyes give it away - too late, usually.
journal.lostfeatures.locked_chest_opened: Hint: Open a Locked Chest with an Ancient Key.
The Emberwrights sealed their best work in strongboxes that open only to ruby-tipped keys.
journal.lostfeatures.mechanism_built.hin: Hint: Craft or activate an ancient mechanism.
journal.lostfeatures.mechanism_built.tex: Their sensors hear the world, their logic stones count and remember. I have rebuilt one.
journal.lostfeatures.notes_decoded.hint: Hint: Combine Encrypted Notes with a Lens Fragment.
journal.lostfeatures.notes_decoded.text: Decoded at last: the Draconic Sigil needs the dust of illusion, the strength of a giant and the wings of a dragon, set around a heart of ruby.
journal.lostfeatures.notes_decoded.title: The Sigil of the Three
journal.lostfeatures.notes_found.hint: Hint: Find Encrypted Notes in ruins or from an Illusioner expedition.
journal.lostfeatures.notes_found.text: Pages of cipher. Illusioners hunt for these too; their expeditions are drawn to the old sites.
journal.lostfeatures.notes_found.title: Encrypted Notes
journal.lostfeatures.reactor_awakened.hi: Hint: Power an Ancient Energy Reactor.
journal.lostfeatures.reactor_awakened.te: Feed it ruby and it pulses with borrowed fire - never for free, always for a price paid in rare things.
journal.lostfeatures.ruby_found.text: Not redstone - ruby. The Emberwrights tuned their machines to its resonance. Where ruby lies near the surface, their ruins are rarely far.
journal.lostfeatures.ruby_found.title: The Red Stone
journal.lostfeatures.sigil_forged.text: Three trophies of three great creatures, bound in ruby. The altar in the dragon lair is waiting.
journal.lostfeatures.sigil_forged.title: The Sigil Forged
journal.lostfeatures.wither_victory.text: The Wither's star burned like a reactor core. The Emberwrights tried to build such engines from ruby instead - and learned to respect their cost.
message.lostfeatures.altar.busy: The Ancestral Red Dragon already roams nearby
message.lostfeatures.altar.disabled: The altar is dormant (disabled in the config)
message.lostfeatures.altar.hint: A socket shaped like a sigil...
message.lostfeatures.edge_compass.disabl: The needle will not move (Far Lands disabled in the config)
message.lostfeatures.edge_compass.missin: The Far Lands are not present on this server
message.lostfeatures.edge_compass.wrong_: The compass only works in the Overworld and the Far Lands
message.lostfeatures.far_lands.no_spawn: You cannot set a spawn point at the edge of the world
message.lostfeatures.locked_chest.locked: Locked. An Ancient Key might fit.
message.lostfeatures.reactor.full: The reactor cannot hold more charge

screen.lostfeatures.journal.world_note: Someone in this world has silenced the Ancestral Dragon.
tooltip.lostfeatures.ancient_bone: From a Giant. Spike traps, bone blocks and plenty of bone meal.
tooltip.lostfeatures.decoded_notes: Translated research. Key to the Draconic Sigil.
tooltip.lostfeatures.draconic_sigil: Use on an Ancient Altar to call the Ancestral Red Dragon.
tooltip.lostfeatures.dragon_fang: Sharp enough to carve into a Fang Blade.
tooltip.lostfeatures.dragon_scale: Fire-tempered. Upgrades an iron chestplate at a smithing table.
tooltip.lostfeatures.encrypted_notes: Ancient research notes. Combine with a Lens Fragment.
tooltip.lostfeatures.giant_trophy: Trophy: proof that a Giant fell.
tooltip.lostfeatures.illusion_dust: Shimmers when nobody is looking. Makes illusory walls.
tooltip.lostfeatures.killer_bunny_trophy: Trophy: you survived the Killer Bunny.
tooltip.lostfeatures.lens_fragment: Reveals hidden writing. Decodes encrypted notes.
tooltip.lostfeatures.quiver.usage: Use: store arrows. Sneak-use: empty. Bows draw from it when you carry no loose arrows.
tooltip.lostfeatures.ruby: A deep red gem. Powers ancient mechanisms.
tooltip.lostfeatures.strength_shard: Crystallised might of a Giant. Reactor fuel and sigil component.
tooltip.lostfeatures.vorpal_fang: From a Killer Bunny. Crafts extra spike traps.
tooltip.lostfeatures.wing_membrane: Tough, light and heat resistant. Part of the Draconic Sigil.
